Agent_1_relevancy_explanation: Very relevant: the ice rink/community complex is a sports/hall building with probably long-span structures and explicitly required structural design (OPQIBI 1902) as well as seismic design and BIM management. The location in France slightly reduces the priority compared to the DACH region, but does not change the technical relevance.
titel: Restricted design competition for the construction of a community complex with ice rink and administrative headquarters in Cherbourg-en-Cotentin
kurzbeschreibung: Design competition for an ice rink and administrative headquarters with complex building and energy requirements.
umfang: New construction of a community complex that combines an ice rink and an administrative headquarters. The notice does not specify concrete areas, spans, GFA or capacities. Technically highlighted are complex building structures, seismic design, buildings with demanding energy processes, in particular cold and heat generation, BIM-based design, deconstruction and existing network diagnostics, as well as 3-year support for operation and maintenance.
leistungen: General planning services within the framework of a restricted competition with basic services ESQ competition design, APS, APD, PRO/DCE, AMT, VISA, DET, AOR as well as additional services OPC, SSI, PEMD, synthesis, operation and maintenance documentation, support for handover to the operator, GED, BIM management, thermal and energy studies, seismic design, construction site environment, environmental impact study, support for operation and maintenance over 3 years, diagnosis of existing networks; architecture, urban planning, structural design and engineering services for complex buildings are expressly required.
relevanzbewertung_erklaerung:
• Strategically relevant architecture and general planning competition for a larger public building with an ice rink.
• Ice rinks are technically demanding due to large column-free spaces, roof structure, cold generation and high integration density.
• Structural design and engineering services for complex buildings are explicitly required as core competencies.
• Early involvement via the competition phase fits well with sbp, even if architectural services are in the foreground.
• Sustainability, energy performance, BIM and technical feasibility are strongly weighted and fit the sbp profile.
• No concrete information on spans, areas or construction costs; therefore the actual relevance for structural design remains unclear.
• The administrative share slightly reduces the relevance, but this is compensated by the ice rink and the competition character.
baukosten_erklaerung: No construction costs are stated in the tender. A reliable estimate is not possible due to the lack of GFA, hall size, spectator capacity, number of ice surfaces, administrative areas and quality standard. Based on the programme of an ice rink plus administrative headquarters, a larger public building with a potentially high cost framework can generally be assumed, but a realistic figure for cost groups 300+400 cannot be reliably derived from the available information.
honorar_erklaerung: No fee for structural design stated. Only a competition compensation of 210000 euros net per eligible team with an assessable sketch is explicitly mentioned; for the winning team this will be offset against later fees. Without construction costs and without allocation of specialist planning services, an sbp-specific fee cannot be reliably determined.
referenzen_qualifikationen: Required are key competencies in architecture, urban planning, heavy and low current, engineering for complex buildings OPQIBI 1902, structural design, sustainable building design OPQIBI 1903, deconstruction planning OPQIBI 1208, thermal design OPQIBI 1327 and 1333, energy performance and climatic building treatment, expertise in cold and heat processes with new technologies, synthesis OPQIBI 0332, energy studies OPQIBI 1326, commissioning of technical installations OPQIBI 1910; further competencies include asbestos remediation OPQIBI 0902, BIM projects OPQIBI 1921 and 1922, fire protection system coordination category A OPQIBI 0321, cost planning OPQIBI 2202, environmental assessment OPQIBI 0612 and 0604, building acoustics OPQIBI 1604, VRD OPQIBI 1812, space planning. Exactly 4 applicants will be invited to the second phase.
zuschlagskriterien: Urban integration and architectural quality 25%; functional coherence, dimensioning and technical feasibility 25%; compatibility with the financial framework and risk control 25%; energy performance and ease of maintenance 25%.
auftraggeber: Communauté d'agglomération du Cotentin, 8 rue des Vindits, 50130 Cherbourg en Cotentin, France. Contact person: CASTELEIN Christèle. E-mail: correspondre@aws-france.com. Website: http://lecotentin.fr. Procurement profile: http://marchespublicsmanche.fr/. Additional information: CA COTENTIN, Delphine ROUSSEAU, 25 rue Dom Pedro, 50100 Cherbourg-en-Cotentin, e-mail: delphine.rousseau@lecotentin.fr.
notes: Competition notice, restricted procedure. Exactly 4 applicants will be invited to the second phase. Competition compensation 210000 euros net for submission of the sketch in the case of compliant performance; reduction or cancellation possible in the event of incomplete or inadequate documents. The subsequent contract will be awarded to one of the competition winners. Submission exclusively electronically and in French.
